name: Motherless
source:
This story is about Sunny, he was separated from his mother at birth, knowing almost nothing about his past, he will try to find her. Help him find his mother and you will be rewarded during this process.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2110110/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这个故事是关于桑尼的，他一出生就与母亲失散，对自己的过去几乎一无所知，他会尽力寻找她。帮助他找到他的母亲，在这个过程中你会得到回报。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2110110/]Steam[/url]]
